context: Handling unevenly weighted stock requires supporting its actual load, not its geometric centre. Each sealed bar has a different eccentric mass, so adding the next bar changes the balance of every lower interface. The task tests building a released load-bearing chain of these bars on one narrow support.
fidelity: Rigid boxes represent aluminium tubes with sealed steel weights; native eccentric COM and diagonal inertia retained. Friction is estimated; no crushing or damage model. Fixed steel pedestal/risers and elevated YAM mounts. Arms have27/7Nm gravity-inclusive total limits and40N finger drives. Nonfinger load uses a conservative normal-plus-friction bound; calibration covers fixed42/S, not hardware or all variants.
